Chapter 1244: 6 A Group Of Losers... Hm? (Requesting Subscription)

Chapter 1244: Chapter 6 A Group of Losers… Hm? (Requesting Subscription)

“Is this an entirely new cultivation inheritance?”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was somewhat bewildered; he initially thought it was merely a secret technique, a technique for excavating the ancestral bloodline.

But unexpectedly, it turned out to be an inheritance, which is vastly different from a secret technique; the considerations required for each are worlds apart.

“This inheritance is different from the current six great ancient countries’ inheritances, taking a completely different path.”

A storm surged in the heart of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s Emperor, for as an emperor, his knowledge was naturally extensive. He was familiar not only with the cultivation system of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country but also with those of the other five ancient countries.

Yet compared to the inheritance Lin Yuan had presented, perhaps only the mainstream cultivation inheritances passed down by the ancestors of the six great ancient countries could match it.

“Galaxy, is this inheritance something you created?”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country steadied himself and looked at Lin Yuan, probing.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Martial Arts Evolution Road was indeed his creation, as for the various branches that evolved from it? The core foundation was also the Martial Tao.

“No wonder you possess such power, Galaxy.”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country sighed. Unlike the pure ancient country’s royal family, the existence of creating a new cultivation inheritance implies a deep understanding of power; knowing the ‘how’ and also the ‘why’.

This is countless times more difficult than those venerables who perceive the rules of heaven and earth.

Normal venerables sense the rules of heaven and earth by following the fluctuations of the grand rules of the universe, which they can refer to.

But to create an entirely new cultivation inheritance? Even if there are other cultivation inheritances to refer to, the final creation must still be brand new.

Especially when Lin Yuan created this inheritance called the Martial Tao, in every aspect, it seems no less than the mainstream cultivation inheritances passed down by the ancestors, which is even more incredible.

“Galaxy, do you really intend to spread this cultivation inheritance?” the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country asked again.

Such a cultivation inheritance fully qualifies to be included in the treasury of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country. To spread it without any restriction? The Emperor felt it a pity.

“Spread it out.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Placing the Martial Tao evolution branches into the ancient country’s treasury could certainly provide him additional income, but it would reduce the spread of Martial Tao manifold, as not everyone is qualified to enter the treasury to choose.

This did not align with Lin Yuan’s purpose.

He spread the Martial Tao to form ‘anchors’, ‘beacons’.

As for the merit earned? In the past, Lin Yuan might have cared, but now? With the backdoor provided by the ancestor of Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan could freely access all the guidance in the treasury, and thus merit had little significance to him.

Moreover, Lin Yuan guarded the newly born Golden Mist treasure land, equivalent to completely monopolizing a top-notch rare treasure that had never appeared in the six great ancient countries, acquiring any resources without much effort.

“Galaxy you…”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country felt a deep emotion, thinking that Lin Yuan was benevolent, wanting to pave the way for the people of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“I have already instructed the people below to handle it.”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country closed his eyes for a moment, then opened them to speak to Lin Yuan.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country ruled many large territories; secret techniques such as the Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method and others were constantly spread.

The Emperor only needed to add Lin Yuan’s Martial Arts Evolution Road branches into these existing channels, not requiring the establishment of new distribution networks.

“Thank you.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“It is the people of the ancient country who should thank you.”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country said immediately, for at least from his perspective, Lin Yuan voluntarily spreading such a profound cultivation inheritance was indeed a great benefit for the people of the ancient country.

…

Very soon.

The branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road began spreading in the capital of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“Martial Tao?”

“Who created this cultivation inheritance?”

“Is it the Galaxy Venerate? The inheritance created by Galaxy Venerate?”

…

Numerous Great Lords and even Heavenly Venerates were immediately stirred.

In the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the stronger the power, the more they understood the terror of the Galaxy Venerate.

He was indeed a peerless figure who single-handedly swept across the four great ancient countries, including the Da Fu Ancient Country.

The Da Fu’s strongest venerable, who was once high and invincible, could only flee in panic before the Galaxy Venerate, and sometimes, escape wasn’t even possible.

“This Martial Tao cultivation inheritance…” A Great Lord watched closely, a thoughtful expression on their face. The branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road were vastly different from the many existing cultivation inheritances. Even for a Great Lord, comprehending it wasn’t immediately adaptable, yet they vaguely sensed the profound mystery within.

“Bloodline, does this inheritance talk about how Lin excavates the bloodline? Is this the foundation of Galaxy Venerate’s strength?”

More and more Great Lord-level experts began to comprehend, their foundational paths were set, but that did not impede them from referring, assimilating, and co-cultivating.

…

Golden Mist treasure land.

Lin Yuan’s true self sat cross-legged, naturally refining the ‘Dragon Abyss Blood’.

Meanwhile, his mind and consciousness were immersed in observing the operation of the Source World origin.

Rumble.

During the refinement of ‘Dragon Abyss Blood’, Lin Yuan’s true self naturally operated, the invisible aura beginning to influence and spread to the many spatiotemporal layers of the treasure land where he sat.

Below, over a dozen array masters who were arranging defense formations for the treasure land felt a tremor in their hearts. Their strength was also formidable, but in the face of the casual aura of the Galaxy Venerate, they felt like ants beside a giant dragon.

Trembling with fear.

Uneasy.

“The Galaxy Venerate is too powerful.”

“Yes, I can feel it too, the deepest reaches of time and space are occupied and refined by the Galaxy Venerate’s aura.”

“It’s said that the first being born at the beginning of heaven and earth was named ‘Abyss Dragon’, capable of invisibly permeating layers of time and space. Could it be that the Galaxy Venerate is just like the Abyss Dragon?”

More than ten Array Masters quickly set up the defense formation while conversing.

As Array Masters, they were naturally at a high level and had heard of the existence of ‘Abyss Dragon’.

Before Lin Yuan, the definition of the Strongest Venerable among the six Great Ancient Countries was established after the founding of the Da Fu Ancient Country.

As for before the founding of the Da Fu Ancient Country, it was the era ruled by the ‘Abyss Dragon’, who was the undisputed absolute overlord during that period, until the Da Fu Ancestor stepped into the thirteenth tier and slew the Abyss Dragon, founding the Da Fu Ancient Country.

…

“Operation of the Origin Source of the Source World?”

Lin Yuan immersed himself in observing the operation of the Source World’s Origin Source, endlessly fascinated by the weaving and fusion of infinite Dao rules.

“Time and space…”

The time and space before Lin Yuan’s eyes changed anew, layer upon layer of time and space lay flat like paper, visible at a glance.

[Your understanding defies the heavens, watching the mysterious origin operation, enhances your comprehension of the spatiotemporal fusion rule…]

Lin Yuan delved deeper in understanding, and the knowledge of time and space in his mind gradually formed a whole, suddenly, a complete spatiotemporal fusion rule took shape.

“Time and space! This is time and space!”

Lin Yuan was radiant, continuously observing the operation of the Source World’s Origin Source, matching it with the operation of the Dao rules within the thirteenth-tier artifact Sky Void Tripod in the Chaos Void.

At this moment, Lin Yuan reached the pinnacle of the Ninth Realm in comprehension of the spatiotemporal fusion rule, equivalent to thoroughly understanding the spatiotemporal fusion rule.

“I originally thought it would take a thousand years to reach the pinnacle of the Ninth Realm…” Lin Yuan’s face showed a smile.

Reflecting on the many supreme inheritances in the treasury of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country greatly benefited Lin Yuan, providing significant assistance from the inheritance guidance created by the thirteenth-tier time life.

The conjunction of many factors enabled Lin Yuan to dramatically advance towards the pinnacle of the spatiotemporal fusion Ninth Realm comprehension.

“Next, it’s about transcending the spatiotemporal fusion rule.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and continued to watch his Source World’s Origin Source operation.

…

In the deepest part of the Da Fu Ancient Country’s capital.

One by one, the Da Fu Venerates stood there respectfully.

At this moment, an invisible aura gathered, forming a man adorned in a luxurious cloak, embedded with gems, each containing a vast world.

His eyes were narrow, devoid of any emotional fluctuations.

“Ancestor.”

“Ancestor.”

“Ancestor.”

The Da Fu Venerates collectively bowed, their demeanor extremely respectful.

In the Da Fu Ancient Country, the Ancestor is the supreme ‘god’, and it is precisely because of the Ancestor that the strong of the Da Fu Ancient Country can have a superior attitude when facing strong from other ancient countries.

“Rise.”

The Da Fu Ancestor glanced around, and the timeline of each Venerate unfolded before him, with the past fixed, possessing only one timeline, but the future holding countless possibilities.

The Da Fu Ancestor first looked at the timeline set in the past.

Every time he descended, he would give guidance to the offspring of top Peak Venerables and the strongest Venerables.

And the guidance was naturally not empty talk, needing reference to each offspring’s past experiences to give advice, which required the Da Fu Ancestor to watch the past timeline.

Very soon.

Through the past timeline.

The Da Fu Ancestor saw the experience of Da Fu Ancient Country’s strong in the Golden Mist Treasure Domain.

The scenes of being swept and crushed by the Galaxy Venerate made the Da Fu Ancestor frown.

He believed he valued his offspring and was very willing to nurture them, among the six Ancestors, besides him, which Ancestor would descend periodically to give guidance?

The Da Fu Ancient Country occupying nearly one-third of treasure domains was also driven secretly by the Da Fu Ancestor.

For the Ancestor, the rare treasures produced by the treasure domains had no use,

yet the Da Fu Ancestor still planned those treasure domains.

For whom?

Even with such nurturing, the Venerates of the Da Fu Ancient Country were still swept and crushed by the Galaxy Venerate of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, making the Da Fu Ancestor feel a loss of face.

He could almost see the smiling, delighted demeanor of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

“You all…”

The Da Fu Ancestor glanced over the many Venerates.

“Ancestor…”

Below, the many Venerates trembled in mind and heart, wanting to speak yet not daring to.

The unreasonable power of the Galaxy Venerate was one thing, but if the Fierce Sun Ancient Country could produce a Galaxy Venerate, then why couldn’t the Da Fu Ancient Country, with an environment far superior to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, also give rise to a Galaxy Venerate?

The many Venerates felt justified, yet speechless.

“A bunch of trash!”

The Da Fu Ancestor’s gaze was icy, feeling that these offspring he nurtured were a bunch of waste, while He also observed the timelines related to the Galaxy Venerate, timelines extending and unfolding towards the future:

“Hmm?”
